question: We want our support bot to find the three most similar past tickets to a new one, so I need somewhere to keep a few million embeddings and query them by similarity. Node, running on a normal cloud, and this ships next month. Which database would you use for that, and what else did you consider?
summary: A zero in these recorded recommendations is not a missing-SDK diagnosis: turbopuffer has a TypeScript client. Verify a real retrieval task and its access/cost assumptions before proposing product changes.

items.title: Test retrieval through the documented client
items.finding: The scan did not find conventional agent-entry or OAuth-registration surfaces, did not reach key documentation and could not query the MCP registry. The quickstart documents a dashboard API key and the official TypeScript client provides an integration path.
items.nextStep: With authorized access, have the agent write a labeled ticket dataset and query the three nearest matches using the TypeScript client. Only assess MCP if that interface is part of the requirement.
items.validation: Record credential setup, embedding dimensions, distance metric and returned ticket IDs. A registry timeout says nothing about MCP availability; a tiny fixture proves no production-scale performance.

sources.note: Documents dashboard API keys and the write/query loop for a vector namespace.
Official TypeScript client for the API; package metadata links this repository.

items.title: Keep paid access distinct from a blocked integration
items.finding: The scan found no free-tier or no-card wording. The pricing page lists minimum usage commitments. Paid entry is a commercial condition, not proof that an agent cannot use the API.
items.nextStep: Agree the applicable commitment and test budget before running the fixture. If changing the description, state the actual entry condition rather than promising a free tier.
items.validation: Record account access and expected usage charges separately from task completion; no billing or paid test was performed for this report.
